description: Every city where Luxury Lodging has directly bookable homes, with the state or region, the country, how many homes and the largest group each can sleep. Counts are given for the city alone and for the wider area a search covers, split into whole homes and rooms. It shows whether a destination is covered, including when a guest has not named a place.
name: list_markets

collection_url.description: The public page for this market, when it has enough homes to have one. It lists the homes and their neighbourhoods.

country.description: Not every destination is in the United States; two cities can share a name across countries.

counts.description: The same stays split into whole homes and rooms, for the city alone and for the area. homes includes unknown_type; a room is not a whole home.

homes.description: Entire homes, plus homes whose type is not recorded (unknown_type).

unknown_type.description: Counted inside homes: nothing on record says whether these are whole homes.

homes.description: Entire homes, plus homes whose type is not recorded (unknown_type).

unknown_type.description: Counted inside homes: nothing on record says whether these are whole homes.

homes_in_area.description: Stays a search for this market returns before dates, including nearby cities (Chicago: 65 miles around the city). At least homes.

sleeps_max.description: The largest group any single home in this market sleeps.

state.description: State, province or region as the provider files it.

summary.description: The counts as a guest reads them, e.g. "41 stays in Chicago · 47 in the Chicago area, including 13 private rooms".

title: List destinations
